# ~ans104@1.0

The ANS-104 data-item codec used for Arweave bundles and nested data items.

## When To Use It

- Serialize and deserialize ANS-104 data items.
- Commit and verify bundled messages.
- Prepare messages for `~bundler@1.0` and Arweave upload.

## Action Keys

| Key | What it does |
|---|---|
| `to/from` | Convert between HyperBEAM message form and ANS-104 record form. |
| `serialize/deserialize` | Encode or decode ANS-104 bytes. |
| `commit/verify` | Sign or verify ANS-104 commitments. |

## Local Examples

### Commit a message through the ANS-104 codec

```text
curl -sS -X POST \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data-binary '{"data":"hello ANS-104","content-type":"text/plain","app-name":"hb-device-docs"}' \
  "http://localhost:8734/~message@1.0/commit&commitment-device=ans104@1.0&type=unsigned/~json@1.0/serialize"
```

Expected: a structured message with an `ans104@1.0` commitment and stable unsigned ID. The head device is `message@1.0`; ANS-104 is the commitment/serialization device doing the transform.

### Serialize a signed data item with HyperBEAM

```text
cat > /tmp/hb-ans104-item.json <<'JSON'
{
  "data": "hello from HyperBEAM ANS-104 bytes",
  "content-type": "text/plain",
  "app-name": "hb-device-docs"
}
JSON
curl -sS -X POST \
  -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  --data-binary @/tmp/hb-ans104-item.json \
  "http://localhost:8734/~message@1.0/commit&commitment-device=ans104@1.0&type=signed/~ans104@1.0/serialize" \
  -o /tmp/hb-ans104-item.bin
wc -c /tmp/hb-ans104-item.bin
```

Expected: `/tmp/hb-ans104-item.bin` contains signed ANS-104 data-item bytes produced by the local HyperBEAM node. This requires the node to have a signing wallet configured as `priv-wallet`; without one, signing should fail instead of silently producing unsigned bytes.

### Decode those ANS-104 bytes through HyperBEAM

```text
curl -sS -X POST \
  -H 'content-type: application/octet-stream' \
  --data-binary @/tmp/hb-ans104-item.bin \
  "http://localhost:8734/~ans104@1.0/deserialize/~json@1.0/serialize"
```

Expected: HyperBEAM parses the binary item into a structured message with data/tags/commitments. This is the practical “deserialize ANS-104” path.

### Submit the same signed item to the bundler path

```text
curl -sS -X POST \
  -H 'content-type: application/octet-stream' \
  --data-binary @/tmp/hb-ans104-item.bin \
  "http://localhost:8734/~bundler@1.0/item?codec-device=ans104@1.0"
```

Expected: the bundler accepts only if `ans104@1.0` can deserialize and verify the data item. This is the operator-facing use case: signed item bytes become cacheable/bundleable HyperBEAM messages.

## Composition

- Use with `~bundler@1.0`, `~arweave@2.9/tx`, and `~httpsig@1.0` commitment flows.

## Trust And Operation

ANS-104 verification proves data-item commitments; upload availability still depends on the bundler and Arweave route.
